400.title: Bad Request
400.description: The server cannot process the request due to a client error.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.description: Authentication is required to access this resource.

403.title: Forbidden
403.description: You do not have permission to access this resource.

404.title: Not Found
404.description: The requested resource could not be found.

408.title: Request Timeout
408.description: The server timed out while waiting for the request.

413.title: Payload Too Large
413.description: The request payload is too large for the server to process.

500.title: Internal Server Error
500.description: The server encountered an unexpected condition.

503.title: Service Unavailable
503.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
